description.value: Cat's Coffee & Cake is a café situated on Douglas Street in downtown Victoria, BC. Its central location on a major arterial street makes it a potentially convenient stop for cyclists passing through the city core. No further details about the business could be confirmed due to the inaccessibility of its website.

The URL was discovered with only medium confidence, adding further uncertainty about whether this Facebook page is even the correct one.
